packageRules.description: Daily rollup PR for all patch + minor + digest updates. Renovate keeps rebasing it through the day as new updates arrive; CI runs once per rebase; auto-merge fires when green. The 24h release-age gate keeps us out of the npm/pypi malware-yank window — typo-squatted or compromised packages almost always get pulled within that window.

Major updates stay one PR per package. They're breaking changes that need individual review and may need follow-up code edits; bundling them would mean a single bad major holds everything else hostage.
